deployment_note: Copy of the CV-selected, train-fitted classifier bundle. Not refit on the full dataset.
dataset_provenance: condition-matched farmer records (5 estates, Jun-Sep 2026) with Open-Meteo weather; DRC/Metrolac values normalized by the dataset author; latex price derived from farm-gate levels (Jun-Sep 2026 levels estimated)
target_warning: Rule-derived proxy labels from rainfall thresholds, judged on rain that actually fell; the model sees only the forecast issued beforehand (no added noise). NOT expert-verified tapping advice.
